verses.text: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the seventh year, some of the elders of Israel came to ask the LORD for advice, and they sat down in front of me.
Then the LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Have you come to ask me for advice? As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will not let you ask me for advice.'
Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Then make them aware of the disgusting things their ancestors did.
Tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I chose Israel, I made a promise to the descendants of Jacob and made myself known to them in Egypt. I swore to them, "I am the LORD your God."
On that day I promised them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.
I told them, "Each of you must throw away the vile images you look to. Do not make yourselves unclean with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God."

But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me. They did not throw away the vile images they looked to, and they did not give up the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my fury on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.

But I acted for the sake of my name, so that it would not be dishonored in the eyes of the nations they lived among. In the sight of those nations I had made myself known to the Israelites by bringing them out of Egypt.
So I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
I gave them my rules and taught them my laws. Whoever obeys them will live by them.
I also gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so that they would know that I, the LORD, am the one who makes them holy.

But the people of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not follow my rules, and they rejected my laws, though whoever obeys them will live by them. And they completely dishonored my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my fury on them in the wilderness and destroy them.
But I acted for the sake of my name, so that it would not be dishonored in the eyes of the nations who had watched me bring them out.
I also swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.
I did this because they rejected my laws, did not follow my rules, and dishonored my Sabbaths. Their hearts were devoted to their idols.
Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them. I did not wipe them out in the wilderness.
I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not follow the rules of your parents or keep their laws or make yourselves unclean with their idols.
I am the LORD your God. Follow my rules and be careful to keep my laws.
Keep my Sabbaths holy, so that they will be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God."

But the children rebelled against me. They did not follow my rules or carefully keep my laws, though whoever obeys them will live by them. And they dishonored my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my fury on them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.
But I held back my hand and acted for the sake of my name, so that it would not be dishonored in the eyes of the nations who had watched me bring them out.
I also swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and spread them throughout the countries,
because they had not kept my laws. They had rejected my rules and dishonored my Sabbaths, and their eyes longed for their parents' idols.
So I let them follow rules that were not good and laws they could not live by.
I let them make themselves unclean through their own gifts, when they sacrificed every firstborn child in the fire. I did this to fill them with horror, so that they would know that I am the LORD.'
So, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: In this way too your ancestors insulted me by being unfaithful to me.

When I brought them into the land I had promised to give them, they looked for every high hill and every leafy tree, and there they offered their sacrifices. There they made offerings that made me angry. There they offered their sweet-smelling incense and poured out their drink offerings.
Then I asked them, "What is this high place you go to?" And it is still called Bamah, which means high place, to this day.'
So tell the people of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Will you make yourselves unclean the way your ancestors did? Will you chase after their vile images like a prostitute?

When you offer your gifts and sacrifice your children in the fire, you are making yourselves unclean with all your idols to this day. So should I let you ask me for advice, people of Israel? As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will not let you ask me for advice.
What you have in mind will never happen. You say, "We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of other countries, who worship wood and stone."
As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will rule over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with my fury poured out.
I will bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with my fury poured out.
I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and there I will judge you face to face.
Just as I judged your ancestors in the wilderness of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord GOD.
I will count you as you pass under my shepherd's staff, and I will bring you under the terms of the covenant.

I will remove from among you those who rebel and turn against me. I will bring them out of the land where they are living, but they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

As for you, people of Israel, this is what the Lord GOD says: Go ahead, each of you, and serve your idols, if you will not listen to me. But you will no longer dishonor my holy name with your gifts and your idols.

For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, says the Lord GOD, all the people of Israel will serve me in the land. There I will accept them. There I will ask for your offerings, your best gifts, and all your holy sacrifices.

When I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, I will accept you like sweet-smelling incense. I will show my holiness through you while the nations watch.
Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I promised to give your ancestors.
There you will remember your ways and all the things you did that made you unclean. You will hate yourselves for all the evil you have done.
You will know that I am the LORD when I deal with you for the sake of my name and not as your evil ways and corrupt actions deserve, people of Israel, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face toward the south. Preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southern land.

Say to the southern forest, 'Listen to the LORD's message. This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to set you on fire, and it will burn up all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be put out, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.
Everyone will see that I, the LORD, have set it on fire. It will not be put out.'"
Then I said, "Oh, Lord GOD! They are saying about me, 'He is just telling stories.'"
